author: Edcookie274
body:
it was around 11:40 am LA time. Team PVP red vs blue. I was in the red team, and tylerghernandez in the blue... and he starts pounding us all while we couldnt even reach him. Even got to the spawn and kept KOing us. While it was funny to me many other reds were reporting him and so did i. He challenged us to do /report so i just came to the forums as well. the bad thing is I got no evidence and he left even though the abuse of hacks lasted about 10 minutes... :( (sorry guys) hope you guys can keep an eye on him. or hopefully someone else has evidence. 

LOVE YOU GUYS.
Random MC playa (who happens to lag no matter what TWC plan i get XD)
